description: The surah that opens with the unnerving, cataclysmic sign of the end of the world coming and **The Moon** having split apart. It takes its name from verse 1 which mentions "the moon" (qamar), that here serves as a reference to the Day of Resurrection. The surah deals mainly with the punishment dealt out to previous generations of disbelievers. These are presented as a warning to the disbelievers of Mecca, with the refrain "is there anyone who will be admonished?" running throughout the surah. Finally the treatment of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgement is contrasted to the everlasting bliss the believers will enjoy.

9.1: Or 'he was proscribed,' or 'he was ostracized.'

translations.1:
The Hour has drawn near
 and the moon is split.
translations.2:
If they see a sign, they turn away,
 and say, 'An incessant<{["F", 1]}> magic!'
translations.3:
They denied, and followed their own desires,
 and every matter has a setting [appropriate to it].
translations.4:
There have already come to them reports
 containing admonishment,
translations.5:
[and representing] far-reaching wisdom;
 but warnings are of no avail!
translations.6: So _turn away_ from them! The day when the Caller calls to a dire thing,
translations.7:
with a humbled look [in their eyes],
  they will emerge from the graves
   as if they were scattered locusts,
translations.8: scrambling toward the summoner. The faithless will say, 'This is a hard day!'
translations.9:
The people of Noah impugned before them. So they impugned Our servant and said,
 'A crazy man,' and he was reviled.<{["F", 1]}>
translations.10:
Thereat he invoked his Lord,
 [saying,] 'I have been overcome, so help [me].'
translations.11:
Then We opened the gates of the sky
  with pouring waters,
translations.12:
and We made the earth burst forth with springs,
  and the waters met for a preordained purpose.
translations.13:
We bore him
  on a vessel made of planks and nails,
translations.14:
which sailed [over the flood waters] in Our sight,
  as a retribution for him who was repudiated.
translations.15:
Certainly We have left it as a sign;
  so is there anyone who will be admonished?
translations.16: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
translations.17:
Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple
  for the sake of admonishment.
 So is there anyone who will be admonished?
translations.18:
[The people of] 'Ād impugned [their apostle].
 So how were My punishment and My warnings?
translations.19:
Indeed We unleashed upon them an icy gale
   on an incessantly ill-fated day,
translations.20:
knocking down people
   as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
translations.21: So how were My punishment and My warnings?!
translations.22:
Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple
  for the sake of admonishment.
 So is there anyone who will be admonished?
translations.23: [The people of] Thamūd denied the warnings,
translations.24:
and they said,
 'Are we to follow a lone human from ourselves?!
 Indeed then we would be in error and madness.'
translations.25:
'Has the Reminder been cast upon him
  from among us?
 Rather he is a self-conceited<{["F", 1]}> liar.'
translations.26:
'Tomorrow they will know
   who is a self-conceited liar.
translations.29:
But they called their companion,
 and he took [a knife] and hamstrung [her].
translations.30: So how were My punishment and My warnings?!
translations.31: We sent against them a single Cry, and they became like the dry sticks of a corral builder.
translations.32:
Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple
  for the sake of admonishment.
 So is there anyone who will be admonished?
translations.33: And the people of Lot denied the warnings.
translations.34:
We unleashed a rain of stones upon them,
  excepting the family of Lot,
   whom We delivered at dawn,
translations.35:
as a blessing from Us.
 Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
translations.36:
He had certainly warned them of Our punishment,
  but they disputed the warnings.
translations.37:
Certainly they even solicited of him his guests,
  whereat We blotted out their eyes, [saying,]
  'Taste My punishment and My warnings!'
translations.38:
Certainly early at dawn there visited them
  an abiding punishment:
translations.40:
Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple
  for the sake of admonishment.
 So is there anyone who will be admonished?
translations.41: Certainly the warnings came to Pharaoh's clan
translations.42:
who denied all of Our signs.
 So We seized them with the seizing
  of One [who is] all-mighty, Omnipotent.
translations.43:
Are your faithless better than those,
 or have you [been granted] some immunity
  in the scriptures?
translations.44: Do they say, 'We are a confederate league'?
translations.45:
The league will be routed
  and turn its back [to flee].
translations.46:
Rather the Hour is their tryst;
 and the Hour will be most calamitous and bitter.
translations.47: Indeed the guilty are in error and madness.
translations.48:
The day when they are dragged into the Fire
  on their faces,
 [it will be said to them,] 'Taste the touch of hell!'
translations.49: Indeed We have created everything in a measure,
translations.50:
and Our command is but a single [word],
   like the twinkling of an eye.
translations.51:
Certainly We have destroyed your likes.
  So is there anyone who will be admonished?
translations.52: Everything they have done is in the books,
translations.53: and everything big and small, is committed to writing.
translations.54:
Indeed the Godwary
  will be amid gardens and streams,
translations.55:
in the abode of truthfulness<{["F", 1]}>
  with an omnipotent King.
